steps: Title: tapped biggest button Take office as United States
Picked Guide me in the news question
Executed 12 months, mostly with defaults, twice picked the aggressive option
scenarios.notes: Started in under 20 s, first consequence at month 1. Lost the mission (Israel relations) which I never knew mattered.

steps: Reached verdict, achievements, moments, numbers, truth, ranking
scenarios.notes: Share card is small landscape text on a phone; Phone card tap showed no visible change.

friction.where: Month 1 briefing, What is going on here
friction.happened: full-screen wall of text with map and 4 people
crisis headline and text fill the screen; the options are below the fold and I had to scroll inside the page

friction.expected: my tapped pick to be chosen
friction.happened: a default (Cabinet pick) was already decided; I executed without choosing the strike
mission bar changed goal names every month (shooting stops, approval, stability, Israel); never clear which one I fail on
sat at 4 to 6 unspent for most of the game, nothing told me what to spend it on
two labels overlap (Mobilize forces / Israel stays on side)
8 pages after the verdict (verdict, achievements, moments, seen, numbers, truth, ranking, share)
nothing visibly happened; card shown is landscape with tiny text
score and grade count up from 0 and show 0 stars, 3 empty stars on a D
Muscat, IRGC, Congress, minehunters, framework, enrichment, Kramatorsk, sanctions, ceasefire: I did not know them; underlines and i badges helped a bit for names but I did not tap them
The war with Iran is over, with no explanation
clear, Guide me was easy to pick, but it then opened a briefing wall on every crisis

bugs.title: Moments timeline labels overlap
bugs.actual: two labels draw on top of each other

bugs.title: Phone card button gives no visible result

suggestions.what: Put 2 or 3 big option cards right under the crisis title and skip the full briefing unless tapped
Say in the month header which single goal I am losing and a button to fix it
Short verdict with big grade and one share button first; the rest optional
Portrait share card sized for a phone story

delight: Month recap scene with big +8 or +12 number and IT WORKED / A STEP BACK stamp
Animated scene art on each crisis

fun.reason: Big stamps and numbers were fun; most months were just pressing Execute

clarity.reason: Could not tell what the mission was or why I failed it

visual.reason: Good art, scene cards and stamps

feels_like_a_game.reason: Feels like a game in recaps, like a menu on the desk

agency.reason: Scrolling to find options, defaults pre-chosen, failed taps looked like nothing happened

realism.reason: Believable headlines, but I cannot judge

replay.reason: Replay same opening button is nice; D grade makes me want one retry

recommend.reason: Cool look, but too much reading and a long ending for a quick phone game

quit_point: Would have quit at month 1 briefing wall of text (about 40 s in), and likely stopped after month 5 when nothing new happened by just pressing Execute
verbatim: it looks sick but why did I fail, what even is Israel stays on side
